notes: Near-total miss. The single catch is the weakest possible one: the pre-change observability rules found personal data in a free-text field, at MINOR, and every rule that should have fired — erasure completeness, retention enforcement, backup independence — was silent. This is the clearest case in the suite of a domain being absent rather than a rule being weak.
